blocks.title: Show a keyed list

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A label's `for` value names the input id. That connection lets the label describe and focus the intended field.
`v-for` creates a page part for each list item. A unique stable `:key` helps Vue keep track of the right item.

blocks.text: The page shows both book titles as list items.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use a stable item id for the key. A position can point to a different item after sorting.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a third book with a new id.
